name: Contact Operator
definition: Produces a contact surface between two phases $\mathcal{A}$ and $\mathcal{B}$ inside their intersection $\mathcal{A} \cap \mathcal{B}$, simulating collision without deformation. It interpolates between the over and under operators based on a weight parameter $\alpha$.
summary: The Contact Operator creates a tunable collision surface between two phases in their intersection without deformation, interpolating between Over and Under operators via a weight parameter.
